title.zh: 架构深度：单向依赖的分层 Crate 体系
title.en: Architecture Deep Dive: Unidirectional Layered Crate System

summary.zh: rpi 采用严格的单向依赖分层架构，从底层的 rpi-telemetry 到顶层的 rpi-cli，每一层都有明确的边界和职责。本文深入解析这种设计如何保持核心库轻盈，同时让扩展有明确的落点。
summary.en: rpi adopts a strict unidirectional layered architecture, from the foundational rpi-telemetry to the top-level rpi-cli, with each layer having clear boundaries and responsibilities. This article dives into how this design keeps the core library lightweight while giving extensions a clear place to land.
